description: This file defines the interface ITransactionalResource for transaction participants within Orleans transactions, specifying methods for commit, abort, cancel, and confirm actions.

classes.name: ITransactionalResource
classes.description: Interface that allows a component to be a transaction participant, defining transaction-related methods.

methods.name: CommitReadOnly
methods.description: Handles read-only transaction commit request; returns a status after attempting to commit.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Prepares a transaction participant for commit; used as a one-way message except for response purposes.

methods.name: Abort
methods.description: Notifies the participant that a transaction has been aborted.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Notifies the participant that a transaction has been canceled/aborted with a reason.

methods.name: Confirm
methods.description: Confirms and commits a transaction after participants have prepared.
